text:
maya_partnerships: Quick pulse: vendor just told us H200 BIOS will slip 72h. We need a contingency for marketplace copy + SI cadence. Thoughts? :warning:

eli_infra: If BIOS slips 72h, our earliest meaningful thermal test shifts out 3 days. B200 fan profile tests look stable. MI300 long-context still unstable for quant paths.

prudence_si: SI: we can do a partial cert for H100+B200 this week, but H200/MI300/Gaudi need vendor artifacts to finish. Recommend we publish H100+B200 and mark others as "validating" to avoid blocking marketplace.

anya_vendor_pm: Confirmed — H200 BIOS candidate now targeted for 2024-05-09T22:00Z (partner bucket). We will add a short release note about BIOS addressing a thermal bias that impacts one power curve. No embargo beyond standard 48h. s3://partners/redwood/h200/1755551111/h200-bios-v2.bin

maya_partnerships: Ok. Action: (1) Publish H100+B200 as initial GA draft but gated behind SI green for B200; (2) add H200/MI300/Gaudi as "validating"; (3) ask vendor to provide sha256 + install instructions in thread.

eli_infra: I'll run a targeted thermal sweep on B200 with `b200-fanv4` tomorrow 06:00 UTC and push image tag `b200-fanv4-1755551111`. Deploy bot will announce smoke.

deploy-bot: image b200-fanv4-1755551111 pushed to staging at 2024-05-07T06:15:00Z; smoke tests queued.

prudence_si: SI slot booked Wed 07:00 UTC for connector + smoke. If H200 BIOS arrives before Tue EOD we'll run a full cert; otherwise we'll publish H100+B200 baseline and add a follow-on joint announcement when H200 is green.

anya_vendor_pm: Uploaded sha256: `a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0`. Will paste install steps into partner bucket README.

maya_partnerships: Great. Keep all artifacts + hashes here. I'll draft the marketplace blurb and ping comms for conditional copy. :memo:
